session_id.description: The support session this token or response describes. Stable for the life of the session.

mode.description: The session's current mode. Every support session starts `read`; an operator-admin switches one session into `edit`, never the other way, and the switch is a one-way door for the life of the session.

operator_name.description: The name of the operator-admin holding this session, for the console banner the operator-admin sees. Only the operator-admin's own console receives it; the customer's audit names every edit as Fleetless-Support, never this name.

expires_at.description: When the session stops being usable regardless of activity, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. A support session has a hard ceiling; nothing extends it past this instant.
